tasks.title: HANGS General Contracting · FY2026 Search for Unrecorded Liabilities
tasks.description: Search HANGS General Contracting LP’s books for liabilities missing at June 30, 2026 from 7 Excel and PDF files: the trial balance, the payables and accruals, the contract schedule, the July to September payments, the invoices still unpaid in October, the vendor invoices selected and the bank’s loan statement. Read every payment and unpaid invoice in scope for June-or-earlier services, test the cut-off and the accruals, and set what was found against materiality. Produce formula-linked workpapers with tickmarks and a draft findings memo. The CPA reviews, decides every open item and concludes; the machine gives no opinion.
tasks.outputs: Two files: formula-linked Excel workpapers with tickmarks and evidence tabs, and a draft findings memo PDF for the CPA with evidence trails and the original files attached
tasks.outputsPath: Outputs/HANGS General Contracting FY2026 Liabilities Audit
tasks.gates: Draft workpapers and findings memo, not reviewed, concluded or signed. Not an audit report and no opinion. Open items stay open. The CPA concludes.
tasks.periodLine: FY2026: liabilities at June 30, 2026 · audit procedures and a draft findings memo for the CPA.
